payload.reason: Classification-based models were not used for the zero-shot experiments because they cannot resolve ties in predictions, which is crucial for ranking tasks. Pairwise ranking and regression approaches provided better performance in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations, making them more suitable for the experiments conducted in Tables 6 and 7.

claims.text: Classification models cannot resolve ties in predictions, making them unsuitable for ranking tasks.
Pairwise ranking and regression approaches performed better than classification in cross-corpus and cross-lingual evaluations.
